title: 第361章 天道契约成第360章 金仙逆伐仙帝
content_zh:
归墟妖尊收敛周身滔天帝威，墨色帝袍无风自动，眼底的杀意彻底褪去，取而代之的是极致的凝重与通透。他活过亿万年，在妖界征战亿万年，从未见过如此逆天的金仙境修士，今日一战，彻底打破了他对修行境界的固有认知。
他静静凝视着身前身姿挺拔、气度超然的追梦，缓缓开口，声音淡漠却笃定无比：“本座知晓你的来意了。”
“以你如今金仙2层巅峰的修为，早已超脱凡界桎梏，起源界、无尽海域的凡界资源，对你而言形同鸡肋，毫无用处。你绝非为寻宝、夺地而来。”
归墟妖尊目光扫过下方遥遥无尽海域，思绪通透澄澈，层层剖析：“你大肆屠戮外海高阶海族、扫荡龙族底蕴、清空海域高端战力，绝非嗜杀。你心知无尽海域万族天赋远超内陆修士，整体战力碾压起源界十大超级大陆。你未来必将飞升上界，超脱凡界，你是提前斩除后患，杜绝你飞升之后，海族大举入侵内陆，屠戮你人族生灵、倾覆你故土疆域。你收割的海量资源，不过顺手为之，皆是为你宗门、亲友、挚爱之人储备的修行底蕴。”
说到此处，他微微顿首，眸光多了几分了然：“除此之外，你此番悍然闯入凶险无尽海域、不惜掀起无边杀戮，还另有核心缘由。你在找人。”
“是你的亲人，或是你放在心上的女子。她们定然误入了无尽海域，甚至遭遇海族觊觎、被妖兽追杀，触怒于你，才让你大开杀戒，横扫四海。”
一番推论，字字精准，句句戳中真相。
追梦神色不变，眼底无半分波澜，默认了他所有猜测。
归墟妖尊轻叹一声，身为妖界至尊仙帝，执掌妖界一方疆域，麾下亿万族群、万千事务缠身，根本不可能滞留凡界，与追梦无休止僵持缠斗。他堂堂仙帝，与一介金仙2层巅峰战成平手，已然颜面尽失，再纠缠不休，只会徒增笑柄。
权衡利弊之后，这位万古妖帝，率先放下身段，选择妥协。
“小辈，你天资万古无双，道心坚不可摧，战力逆伐诸天，本座惜才，亦不愿再结死仇。”归墟妖尊沉声开口，主动开启交涉，“你我就此罢战，各退一步，缔结天道契约，划定山海边界，永世互不侵犯，如何？”
追梦本就无心彻底覆灭无尽海域，此番横扫外海、重创内海龙族、斩断海族高端战力，已然达成杜绝后患的核心目的。如今仙帝现身，再深入核心海域厮杀已然无益，见好就收、定下万世安宁，便是最好的结局。
他微微颔首：“可以。但契约需公允公正，受起源界天道见证约束，永世不得违背。”
话音落下，二人同时凌空端坐，引动起源界亘古天道之力。
苍茫天道轰鸣作响，无形天道法则笼罩整片星空，化作虚无契约卷轴，悬浮于二人中央。
在诸天星辰、天道道则的共同见证下，二人落笔成约，签下万世不朽的山海互不侵犯契约，条款清晰、法则禁锢、违之必遭天谴：
其一、追梦自此停止对无尽海域海族的大规模屠戮，不再主动清剿外海、内海、核心海域海族族群；
其二、无尽海域所有海族势力，十万年内不得踏出海域边界、入侵起源界十大超级大陆分毫，亦不得引妖界强者下界，滋扰内陆人族生灵；
其三、作为对等交换，起源界十大超级大陆仙境以上修士，不得主动跨界闯入无尽海域，肆意屠戮海族、掠夺海域资源；
其四、此契约受起源界天道本源禁锢，双方麾下所有势力、族群尽数绑定，任何人违逆契约，必遭天道反噬、道基崩塌、修为尽废。

契约落笔的刹那，亿亿万丈天道金光横贯星海，无形道印烙印二人神魂、绑定双方族群，永世不消、不可篡改。
自此，起源界内陆与无尽海域，定下十万年太平格局。
契约成型，归墟妖尊深深看了追梦一眼，留下一句“万古天骄，前途无量，愿你他日登临诸天巅峰”，便化作一道黑色帝光，撕裂界面壁垒，重返妖界深处。整片无垠星空，终于彻底恢复安宁。
而这场撼动凡界、惊动星海的旷世大战，动静贯穿无尽海域内外，从外海九龙疆域，到内海龙鹏圣地，再到层层禁制封锁的核心海域边缘，所有海族生灵尽数感知到了那场毁天灭地的对决。
内海深处，一处隐匿于千层海眼、万重禁制之中的隐秘洞府，静谧清幽，与世隔绝。
此处正是小玉与小兰这三年来藏身潜修之地。
当年二女拼死挣脱蛇龙妖修的追杀，误入内海绝境，侥幸寻得这处上古遗留的隐秘洞府，避开了所有海族搜寻，得以安稳闭关修行。三年蛰伏，二人日夜苦修、相辅相成，借助内海浓郁百倍的天地灵气，加之自身极品灵根天赋、追梦传授的无上功法，双双突破桎梏，稳稳踏入合体期一层，已然跻身无尽海域中上层修士行列。
洞府之内，小玉一身素白长裙，眉眼清丽决绝，掌心轻握星辰炎刃；小兰一袭青衫灵动，身姿轻盈挺拔，眼底藏着坚韧执念。两人与追梦分开多年，她们日夜思念追梦，熬过无数孤寂惶恐的日夜，唯一的信念，便是潜心变强，静待重逢之日。
就在二人静心稳固修为之时，外界那贯穿天地的大战波动、撕裂星海的恐怖威能、响彻四海的天地轰鸣，层层穿透禁制，传入洞府之中。
“有人在无尽海域外开战？！”小兰猛地睁眼，眸光震颤。
小玉心头巨震，一股熟悉到极致的道韵气息，跨越万里深海，牢牢牵动着她的心神血脉。那是刻入骨髓、融入神魂的熟悉感，是她日夜思念、朝思暮想的身影独有的道力！
下一瞬，洞府外传来一众贴身侍女急促的禀报声，带着极致的震惊与狂喜：“殿下！两位殿下！天大的喜讯！外界传言，有一位人族无上大能闯入无尽海域，横扫外海九大龙域、屠戮无数高阶海族，独战海域至尊，那人的气息、功法，与两位殿下神识传输给我们灵霄宗追梦公子的信息一模一样！应该是追梦公子！一定是追梦公子来寻你们了！”
content_en:
The Guixu Demon Lord restrained himself from the monstrous imperial power around him, and his dark imperial robe moved without any wind. The murderous intent in his eyes completely faded away, replaced by the ultimate solemnity and transparency. He has lived for hundreds of millions of years and fought in the demon world for hundreds of millions of years. He has never seen such a heaven-defying Golden Immortal monk. Today's battle completely broke his inherent understanding of the realm of cultivation.
He quietly stared at Zhui Meng, who was standing upright and aloof in front of him, and spoke slowly, his voice indifferent but extremely sure: "I know your purpose of coming."
"With your current level of cultivation at the peak of the second level of Golden Immortal, you have already transcended the shackles of the mortal world. The resources of the mortal world in the Origin World and the Endless Sea are useless to you. You are definitely not here to hunt for treasures or seize land."
Demon Lord Guixu scanned the distant and endless sea below, his thoughts were clear and clear, and he analyzed it layer by layer: "You slaughtered the high-level sea people in the outer sea, swept away the dragon family's heritage, and emptied the high-end combat power in the sea. You are by no means bloodthirsty. You know in your heart that the talents of all the races in the endless sea far exceed those of the inland monks, and the overall combat power crushes the top ten super continents in the origin world. . In the future, you will ascend to the upper world and transcend the mortal world. You have to eliminate future troubles in advance to prevent the sea tribe from invading the inland, killing your human beings and overturning your homeland. The vast resources you harvest are just for your sect, relatives, friends, and loved ones. "
At this point, he paused slightly and his eyes became more clear: "In addition, there is another core reason for your brazen intrusion into the dangerous and endless sea and the endless killings. You are looking for someone."
"It's your relatives, or the woman you care about. They must have wandered into the endless sea by mistake, and even encountered the sea tribe's covetousness, being chased by monsters, and angered you, so you let you go on a killing spree and sweep across the sea."
An inference, every word is precise, and every sentence hits the truth.
Zhui Meng's expression remained unchanged, and there was no wave in his eyes, acquiescing to all his guesses.
Demon Lord Guixu sighed lightly. As the Supreme Immortal Emperor of the Demon Realm, he was in charge of a territory of the Demon Realm. He had hundreds of millions of people under his command and was involved in countless affairs. It was impossible for him to stay in the mortal world and fight endlessly with Dream Chaser. He, the majestic Immortal Emperor, had a draw with a second-level Golden Immortal. He had already lost all face. If he continued to pester him, it would only make him a laughing stock.
After weighing the pros and cons, the Eternal Demon Emperor took the lead in putting down his posture and choosing to compromise.
"Junior, your talent is unparalleled, your Taoist heart is indestructible, your fighting power goes against the heavens, I cherish your talent, and I don't want to have any more deadly enemies." Demon Lord Guixu spoke in a deep voice and took the initiative to initiate negotiations, "How about you and I stop fighting, each take a step back, conclude a contract with the way of heaven, demarcate the boundaries of mountains and seas, and never infringe on each other forever?"
Chasing Dreams had no intention of completely destroying the Endless Sea. By sweeping across the outer sea, severely damaging the Dragon Clan in the Inner Sea, and cutting off the high-end combat power of the Sea Clan, it has achieved its core purpose of eliminating future troubles. Now that the Immortal Emperor has appeared, it is no longer useful to go deep into the core sea area to fight. The best outcome is to give up as soon as possible and settle for eternal peace.
He nodded slightly: "Yes. But the contract must be fair and just, bound by the witness of heaven in the origin world, and shall never be violated."
After the words fell, the two of them sat in the air at the same time, activating the eternal power of heaven in the origin world.
The vast sky roared, and the invisible law of heaven enveloped the entire starry sky, turning into a void contract scroll, suspended in the middle of the two.
Witnessed by the stars in the sky and the laws of heaven, the two made a pact and signed an eternal non-aggression contract between mountains and seas. The terms are clear and the laws are strict. Anyone who violates them will be punished by heaven:
First, Zhui Meng will stop the large-scale massacre of the sea tribes in the endless sea, and will no longer take the initiative to clean up the sea tribes in the outer sea, inland sea, and core sea areas;
Secondly, all sea clan forces in the Endless Sea are not allowed to step outside the boundaries of the sea and invade the ten supercontinents of the Origin Realm within a hundred thousand years, nor are they allowed to lure powerful people from the Demon Realm down to the lower realms to disturb the human beings in the interior;
Third, as a reciprocal exchange, monks from the top ten super continents of the Origin Realm and above will not be allowed toTake the initiative to cross borders and break into the endless sea, wantonly slaughter sea people and plunder sea resources;
Fourth, this contract is imprisoned by the origin of the Heavenly Dao in the origin world, and all forces and ethnic groups under both parties are bound. Anyone who violates the contract will be counterattacked by the Heavenly Dao, the foundation of the Dao will collapse, and his cultivation will be ruined.
The moment the contract was signed, billions of feet of heavenly golden light spread across the sea of ​​stars, and the invisible seal imprinted the souls of the two people, binding the two groups, forever, and cannot be tampered with.
Since then, the inland and endless sea areas of the Origin Realm have established a peaceful pattern for a hundred thousand years.
After the contract was formed, Demon Lord Guixu took a deep look at Zhui Meng and left a sentence, "Eternal genius, with a bright future, I hope you can reach the pinnacle of the heavens one day." Then he turned into a black imperial light, tore through the interface barrier, and returned to the depths of the demon world. The entire vast starry sky finally regained its peace.
And this unprecedented battle that shook the mortal world and alarmed the sea of ​​​​stars spread throughout the endless sea and beyond, from the Kowloon territory of the outer sea, to the Holy Land of Longpeng in the inner sea, to the edge of the core sea area with layers of restrictions and blockades. All the creatures of the sea race felt the world-destroying duel.
Deep in the inner sea, there is a secret cave hidden among thousands of layers of sea eyes and thousands of restrictions. It is quiet, quiet and isolated from the world.
This is where Xiaoyu and Xiaolan have been hiding and cultivating for the past three years.
Back then, the two girls fought desperately to escape the pursuit of the snake and dragon demon cultivators and strayed into the desperate situation of the inner sea. Fortunately, they found this secret cave left over from ancient times. They avoided all sea tribe searches and were able to practice in seclusion safely. After three years of dormancy, the two of them practiced hard day and night, complementing each other. With the help of the a hundred times rich spiritual energy of heaven and earth in the inner sea, coupled with their own top-grade spiritual root talents and the supreme skills taught by Dream Chaser, they both broke through the shackles and firmly entered the first level of the integration stage. They have already joined the ranks of the upper-middle-class monks in the Endless Sea.
Inside the cave, Xiaoyu is wearing a plain white dress, her features are clear and resolute, and she holds the star flame blade gently in her palm; Xiaolan is wearing a green shirt and is agile, her body is light and upright, and there is tenacity and obsession hidden in her eyes. The two of them had been separated from Zhui Meng for many years. They missed Zhui Meng day and night. They survived countless lonely and frightening days and nights. Their only belief was to concentrate on becoming stronger and wait for the day when they could meet again.
Just as the two of them were meditating and stabilizing their cultivation, the fluctuations of the war from the outside world, the terrifying power that tore apart the sea of ​​stars, and the roar of heaven and earth that resounded all over the world, penetrated the restrictions layer by layer and entered the cave.
"Someone is starting a war outside the endless sea?!" Xiaolan opened her eyes suddenly, her eyes trembling.
Xiaoyu's heart was shocked. An extremely familiar Taoist aura spread across thousands of miles of deep sea and firmly touched her heart and blood. It was a sense of familiarity that was engraved into the bone marrow and integrated into the soul. It was the unique power of the figure that she missed day and night and thought about day and night!
The next moment, hurried reports from a group of personal maids came from outside the cave, with extreme shock and ecstasy: "Your Highness! Your two Highnesses! Great news! There are rumors from the outside world that there is a supreme human race who broke into the endless sea and swept across the nine dragons in the outer sea. Domain, slaughter countless high-level sea clans, and fight against the supreme master of the sea. The aura and skills of that person are exactly the same as the information transmitted by the consciousness of the two highnesses to our Young Master Dream Chaser! It must be Young Master Chase Dream Chaser!"
